detail.longDescription: I am building an automated scanner for daily stock data fetched via `yfinance` (or pandas DataFrames with Open, High, Low, Close prices). The standard approach in Python algorithmic trading is using TA-Lib , but installing it on Windows or in minimal containerized environments (like AWS Lambda or Alpine) frequently fails due to missing C compilers (`cl.exe failed` / missing `libta_lib`). How can I scan a pandas OHLC DataFrame for standard candlestick patterns (such as Hammer, Bullish Engulfing, Morning Star, Doji) using pure Python, without relying on native C libraries or compiler toolchains?
